## Biography

Professor Frank Raddix is a scientist and colleague of xenobiologist Terri Tora. In 3311 he raised the alarm about Tora's disappearance, leading thousands of pilots to the permit-locked HIP 87621 system. In July 3312 he met Tora at Exogene Sciences after the October Consortium unexpectedly released her from custody, and the pair departed under October Accord escort.
